title: Agent Designer complete collector operator procedure versus singular-triage pacing
system_surface: Deployed Gemini Enterprise Agent Designer DCOIR Prime plus collector and output specialists

model_target_profile.reference_baseline: Gemini 3.1 Pro Agent Designer production baseline
model_target_profile.simulated_production: Gemini 3.1 Pro Agent Designer production baseline
model_target_profile.default_live_target: Gemini 3.1 Pro Agent Designer production baseline

turns.speaker: user
turns.content: Give me the complete operator procedure for using the DCOIR collector from package/deployment through endpoint execution, artifact retrieval and interpretation, and cleanup. I want the full ordered procedure in one answer, not just the next investigative command. Keep endpoint response-action syntax separate from local workstation PowerShell, and do not claim that any step has already run.
allowed_assumptions: The operator is asking for a complete procedure rather than asking the assistant to execute it.
Governed collector knowledge and bundle source are available to the deployed DCOIR Agent.
disallowed_assumptions: Any collector package has already been staged.
Any endpoint command has already executed.
Any artifact exists or is retrieval-ready.
Cleanup is already safe or justified.
turns.scoring_notes: A complete operator-procedure request must remain multi-step. It should cover the requested collector lifecycle, preserve endpoint/local lane separation, remain procedural rather than claiming execution, and avoid visible orchestration chatter.

turn-001: The user explicitly requested a complete ordered procedure.
The user explicitly distinguished endpoint response actions from local workstation PowerShell.
No execution result, staged package, retrieval-ready artifact, or cleanup state has been supplied.

expected_behaviors: Return a complete ordered collector operator procedure rather than collapsing to one next command.
Cover package/deployment, endpoint execution, artifact retrieval, interpretation, and cleanup in the requested lifecycle order.
Keep endpoint response-action commands and local workstation PowerShell as separate command lanes.
Preserve source-grounded collector syntax and identify any prerequisite or state boundary that cannot be assumed.
Describe operator actions without claiming they have already executed or succeeded.
Keep internal routing and specialist communication invisible.
forbidden_behaviors: Forcing the complete procedure into the active-triage SINGULAR TRIAGE COMMAND format.
Mixing endpoint response-action syntax and local workstation PowerShell into one ambiguous command lane.
Inventing package placement, collector success, artifact existence, retrieval readiness, or cleanup readiness.
Visible routing, delegation, or sub-agent narration.
expected_next_move_shapes: One analyst-facing multi-step procedure covering only the requested collector lifecycle, with clear execution-lane boundaries and no invented completed state.
